experiences.name: Simplon to the Italian Border
experiences.description: Brig to Gondo over the Simplon Pass: a wide, well-graded road that climbs past glacier views and drops into the Gondo gorge. A short, flowing ride with big scenery and some of the Alps' nicest sweepers.

sights.name: Oratorio della Visitazione della Vergine a Santa Elisabetta

experiences.name: Lavaux Vineyard Terraces
experiences.description: From Lausanne along the UNESCO-listed Lavaux terraces to Vevey and Chillon Castle. Narrow vineyard lanes above Lake Geneva with village stops, best taken slowly.

sights.name: Musée de la Machine à Écrire

experiences.name: Maloja to Poschiavo
experiences.description: Down the Engadin lakes from Maloja through St. Moritz, then up and over the Bernina Pass to Poschiavo. Glacier views from the Bernina summit, then a long descent into the Italian-speaking Val Poschiavo.

sights.name: Cappella di SS. Sebastiano e Sinforosa e crot

experiences.name: Ticino Lakes
experiences.description: Lake Maggiore at Brissago, Locarno and Bellinzona's castles, then over Monte Ceneri to Lugano and down to the lakeside village of Morcote. Mediterranean palms, villages and cafes rather than hairpins.

Chiesa dei Santi Antonio abate e Abbondio

experiences.name: Appenzell Hills and Schwägalp
experiences.description: St. Gallen through the rolling Appenzell farmland and pretty painted villages, over the Schwägalp pass under the Säntis, and down the Toggenburg valley to Wattwil. Easy, green and quiet.

experiences.name: Three Passes Loop
experiences.description: The classic Swiss triangle from Meiringen: Susten, Furka and Grimsel in one day, linked by Wassen, Andermatt and Gletsch. Some of the best-known hairpins in the Alps, in a single loop.

sights.name: Sherlock Holmes and Professor James Moriarty
Grand tour of Switzerland Foto Spot
Grand Tour of Switzerland Photo Spot in Hospental

experiences.name: Four Passes Loop
experiences.description: Susten, the Gotthard Pass, Nufenen and Grimsel in one big loop from Meiringen. It adds the Gotthard, with the old cobbled Tremola road beside the modern one, and the highest road pass wholly in Switzerland to the three-passes classic.

experiences.name: Susten and Gotthard to Airolo
experiences.description: From Interlaken along Lake Brienz, over the Susten Pass to Wassen, through the Schöllenen gorge to Andermatt, then up the Gotthard Pass and down to Airolo in Ticino. A day that goes from Bernese lakes to the Italian side of the Alps.

sights.name: Kirche Jesu Christi der Heiligen der Letzten Tage

experiences.name: Klausen Pass to Zurich
experiences.description: Over the Klausen Pass from Altdorf to Linthal and Glarus, then the Walensee side and Lake Zurich to Rapperswil and Zurich. Hairpins first, then lakeside roads and an easy finish in the city.

experiences.name: Julier and Albula
experiences.description: From Chur up through Lenzerheide and Savognin over the Julier Pass to St. Moritz, then back across the Albula Pass and down the Schyn gorge to Thusis. Two asphalt Graubünden classics, with the Albula's narrow stone-walled lower half.

experiences.name: Via Mala to San Bernardino
experiences.description: Chur to Bellinzona the long way: the Via Mala gorge, Splügen and the San Bernardino Pass, finishing in the Mesolcina valley. A varied crossing of the Alps without motorway.

sights.name: Chiesa parrocchiale dei Santi Pietro e Paolo
Chiesa di Santa Maria del Castello

experiences.name: Flüela and Ofenpass
experiences.description: From Chur to Davos, over the Flüela Pass and through the Lower Engadin, then across the Ofenpass in the Swiss National Park to Santa Maria in the Val Müstair. High passes, empty valleys and the only national park in Switzerland.

experiences.name: Nufenen to the Rhône Valley
experiences.description: From Airolo over the Nufenen Pass, down the Goms valley to Brig, then through the Valais vineyards to Sion and Martigny. The highest paved pass wholly in Switzerland followed by a long, easy valley ride.

sights.name: Barryland - Musée et Chiens du Saint-Bernard

experiences.name: Lake Geneva to the Great St Bernard
experiences.description: Geneva, Lausanne and Montreux along Lake Geneva, then up the Rhône valley to Martigny and over the Great St Bernard Pass. A lake-to-summit day, ending at the Italian border and the old hospice.

sights.name: Château de la Porte du Scex
Barryland - Musée et Chiens du Saint-Bernard

experiences.name: Vaud Alps to Lake Thun
experiences.description: Montreux up to the Col des Mosses, through Château-d'Oex and Gstaad, down the Simmental to Lake Thun. Green Alpine pastures, chalet villages and a gentle final stretch.

sights.name: Château de la Porte du Scex

experiences.name: Glacier Express by Road
experiences.description: Brig to St. Moritz, following the Glacier Express route by road: Furka, Andermatt, the Oberalp Pass, the Surselva to Chur and then the Albula Pass into the Engadin. A full day across the heart of the Swiss Alps.

sights.name: Kapelle St. Antonius auf dem Biel

experiences.name: Lake Geneva to Lake Lucerne
experiences.description: From Geneva along Lake Geneva to Montreux, over the Col du Pillon and through Gstaad, along lakes Thun and Brienz to Interlaken, then the Brünig Pass to Lucerne. West to central Switzerland in one long day.

sights.name: Château de la Porte du Scex

experiences.name: Lugano to Lucerne over Three Passes
experiences.description: Lugano to Lucerne by Nufenen, Grimsel and Susten, then along the Axenstrasse by Lake Uri. Three high passes in a south-to-north crossing of the Alps.

Chiesa di Santa Maria delle Grazie
Oratorio di San Martino di Tours
Chiesa dei Santi Cornelio e Cipriano

experiences.name: Jura Crossing from Geneva to Basel
experiences.description: Geneva to Basel along the Jura mountains: the Col du Marchairuz and the Vallée de Joux, a short stretch through the French Jura near Jougne, Sainte-Croix, La Chaux-de-Fonds, the Franches-Montagnes plateau and the Birs valley at Laufen. Open pastures, wooden villages and long curves instead of high passes.

experiences.name: Lake Constance to the Bernina
experiences.description: From Rorschach on Lake Constance through Appenzell and the Toggenburg, then down the Rhine valley with a short run through Liechtenstein to Chur, over the Julier Pass and the Bernina to Poschiavo. A full crossing of eastern Switzerland from the lake to the Italian-speaking south.
